diagnostics.resolution: Advance-only correction improved the original NBSP cases but regressed serif signed/RTL cases. Native ink/outer character-response qualification rejects those candidates while retaining the NBSP fix. Trimming a boundary space from its following mark changes grapheme identity, so such trims are declined. Two initial native reference failures came from reusing one Canvas context across typography states; independent fresh per-row native canvases match all 126 native rows. The captured initial failures remain separate observations, not production renderer fixes. A strict raw-RGBA long-line gate later failed: measured alpha 67, area 0.000057843 and centroid 0.00796px show a bounded fractional residual, with zero contour/interior errors; the reconstructed legacy export has alpha 255, area 0.013946 and 1988 contour errors. This remains measured partial SVG fidelity, not byte parity. The same production pilot exposed a 737ms long task; final code retains every edge and splits repeated character-position reads across the scheduling budget, with cancellation checked within the loop. Before-cooperative broad/production passes are retained as historical reports, never added to final counts. Original full-line SVG combining-mark and some font/kerning gaps remain explicitly measured. Sandbox loopback/spawn EPERM failures were rerun in the approved execution environment; final full suite passed.
